title: China's first emperor to Kevin Hart in seven links
description: China's line of emperors, a 1940 handshake, a state visit and three presidents connect Qin Shi Huang to Kevin Hart.
hook: How is Qin Shi Huang connected to Kevin Hart?

links.line: Qin Shi Huang invented the title of emperor, and China's emperors held it for 2,000 years, down to the last one.

image.file: File:Emperor Hirohito Handshakes Emperor Puyi of Manchukuo 26 June 1940.png

links.line: In 1940, China's last emperor, by then Japan's puppet ruler in Manchuria, shook hands with Emperor Hirohito.

image.file: File:President Gerald Ford and Mrs. Betty Ford escort the Emperor and Empress of Japan.jpg

links.line: In 1975, Hirohito made the first state visit to America by a Japanese emperor, hosted by Gerald Ford.

image.file: File:President Clinton with former presidents George H. W. Bush, Gerald Ford, and Jimmy Carter wave from the stage at the dedication of the George H. W. Bush Presidential Library at Texa - DPLA - 34dd2e1f15a119c9c93c3b2c42c179f0.jpg

links.line: In 1997, Ford shared a stage with President Bill Clinton at a presidential library opening in Texas.
At a 2013 White House ceremony, Barack Obama hung the Medal of Freedom around Clinton's neck.

image.file: File:Defense Secretary Ash Carter awards the Honorable Barack H. Obama, 44th President of the United States, with the Department of Defense Medal for Distinguished Public Service.jpg

links.line: In January 2017, Obama's defense secretary Ash Carter gave him the Pentagon's medal for distinguished public service.
At Late Night with Seth Meyers, Ash Carter met Kevin Hart.
